test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Nirbhay can complete a piece of work alone in 19 days and Vismay can complete the same piece of work alone in 6 days. They started the work together, but Nirbhay had to leave 4 days before the completion of the work. In how many days will the work get completed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(19, 6) = 114 units.

Efficiency: **Nirbhay** = 6, **Vismay** = 19.

Trick: When someone leaves **before completion**, add their potential work for those days to the Total Work.

Total units = 114 + (6 × 4) = 114 + 24 = 138 units.

Total time = 138 ÷ (6 + 19) = 138 ÷ 25 = 5(13/25) days.

**∴ The correct answer is 5(13/25) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Nirbhay leaves 4 days before completion.

⇒ Let the total work be completed in **x** days.

⇒ Nirbhay worked for (x − 4) days and Vismay worked for x days.

⇒ 6 × (x − 4) + 19 × x = 114

⇒ 6x − 24 + 19x = 114

⇒ 25x = 114 + 24

⇒ 25x = 138

⇒ x = 138 ÷ 25 = 5(13/25) days.

**∴ The correct answer is 5(13/25) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Leaving Before Completion

If a person leaves **'n' days before completion**, add (Efficiency × n) to total work and divide by combined efficiency.

Leaving After Starting

If a person leaves **'n' days after starting**, subtract (Efficiency × n) from total work and remove that person's efficiency from the denominator.

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the **ratio of work done**, which is (Efficiency × Time) for each individual.</p
